steps.say: The Sun is a star. It is at the centre of the Solar System, and everything else travels around it.
There are eight planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune.
The four planets nearest the Sun are small and rocky. The four furthest away are much bigger and mostly gas or ice.
Asteroids are lumps of rock and comets are balls of ice and dust. They also travel around the Sun.
Other stars can have their own planets. A star with its planets and other objects is a planetary system.

check.prompt: What is at the centre of the Solar System?

options.why: The Earth travels around the Sun.
The Moon travels around the Earth.

hints: It gives us light and heat.
check.explanation: The Sun is at the centre of the Solar System.

check.prompt: Which planet do we live on?

options.why: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun.
Venus is the second planet from the Sun.

hints: It is the third planet from the Sun.
It has liquid water on its surface.
We call our home by this name.
check.explanation: We live on Earth, the third planet from the Sun.
